create.name: Tergar Meditation Community
create.bio:
Tergar Meditation Community is the international network built around the teaching of the Tibetan Buddhist meditation master Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche. Its programmes lead students step by step along two main paths, the Joy of Living and the Path of Liberation, with practice requirements at each level, and a profile feature called My Path records which levels and commitments a student has completed before they register for further courses and retreats.

The community is run by Tergar International, whose office is in Minneapolis. Newcomers can start with a free three-day introductory course of short video teachings and guided meditations by Mingyur Rinpoche, and monthly teachings are shared online. Paid study programmes add live sessions led by Tergar's instructors, and the free Tergar Meditation App lets practitioners log their sessions, track time spent on each practice and build a steady daily habit.

free_resources.title: Tergar Meditation Tracker
free_resources.description: The free web version of the app, for logging meditation sessions and following one's practice over time.

free_resources.title: Feel Better Now: A 3-Day Mini Meditation Journey with Mingyur Rinpoche
free_resources.description: A free three-day introduction with a short video teaching from Mingyur Rinpoche each day, a simple practice, a guided meditation and a reflection to carry into daily life. It centres on resting in awareness and meeting thoughts and emotions with curiosity.

Owner, 10 Nov 2026: list Tergar as an organisation, not an app. Renamed from 'Tergar Meditation App' (slug tergar-meditation-app); bio rewritten by the lead from the plan's own sourced facts; the app is now one part of the listing.
